# New project from this template

1. `./scripts/setup-claude-code.sh`
2. Fill in `decisions/BUSINESS.md`. Until the target, deadline and token budget are set, every session start will say so.
3. Replace the placeholders in `CLAUDE.md`: commands, architecture, invariants.
4. Tier 0 work: branch `fix/…`, `chore/…`, `docs/…` and so on. Anything bigger: `/propose`.

See README.md for how the gate, board and hooks work, and their limits.
